question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Those streets are very __lonely__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Crowded**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is '**lonely**' which means without company or solitary. (बिना किसी कंपनी या अकेले के)
 
• The antonym of 'lonely' would be a word that means crowded or full of people. (भीड़भाड़ वाला या लोगों से भरा हुआ)
 
• So, '**crowded**' is the most appropriate antonym as it means a place or area filled with many people or things.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Isolated **means separated from others or alone, but not necessarily crowded. (दूसरों से अलग या अकेला)
 
• **Empty **means having nothing inside or vacant, which is not opposite to 'lonely'. (अंदर कुछ भी न होना या खाली होना)
 
• **Remote **means far away or distant, but not necessarily crowded. (बहुत दूर)
